ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white/light gray) pixels accounting for approximately 10-15% of the visible surface, primarily localized at scar rings and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigment base with discrete high-contrast white annular rings distributed across both lobes; dense, textured high-intensity clusters are located at the extreme distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation; vertex partially obscured by water turbulence but upper divergent edges suggest an angle of approximately 60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; jagged profile with pixel-level deviations from a smooth curve, most pronounced along the medial-to-distal segments of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Upward sweep with a jagged trailing edge contour; the general trajectory follows a concave curve from the central notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct spatial distribution of roughly 15-20 white annular rings (circular scars) across the fluke surface; higher density on the right lobe medial section.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, sub-linear light-colored disruptions visible on the left lobe surface; potentially shallow scratches or rake marks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Clustered live barnacle colonies at the fluke tips; numerous circular depigmented rosette scars across the dark ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle encrustation specifically concentrated at the lateral tips, altering the smooth geometric profile of the lobe ends.
